verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִידִיתוּן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶֽשְׁמְרָ֣ה דְרָכַי֮ מֵחֲט֪וֹא בִלְשׁ֫וֹנִ֥י אֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה לְפִ֥י מַחְס֑וֹם בְּעֹ֖ד רָשָׁ֣ע לְנֶגְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lī·ḏī·ṯūn miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ā·mar·tî ’eš·mə·rāh ḏə·rā·ḵay mê·ḥă·ṭō·w ḇil·šō·w·nî ’eš·mə·rāh lə·p̄î maḥ·sō·wm bə·‘ōḏ rā·šā‘ lə·neḡ·dî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster For Jeduthun A Psalm of David I said I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present

verses.original: נֶאֱלַ֣מְתִּי ד֭וּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁ֣יתִי מִטּ֑וֹב וּכְאֵבִ֥י נֶעְכָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ne·’ĕ·lam·tî ḏū·mî·yāh he·ḥĕ·šê·ṯî miṭ·ṭō·wḇ ū·ḵə·’ê·ḇî ne‘·kār
verses.literal: I was speechless and still I remained silent [even] from [speaking] good and my sorrow was stirred

verses.original: לִבִּ֨י׀ חַם־ בְּקִרְבִּ֗י בַּהֲגִיגִ֥י אֵ֑שׁ תִבְעַר־ דִּ֝בַּ֗רְתִּי בִּלְשֽׁוֹנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bî ḥam- bə·qir·bî ba·hă·ḡî·ḡî ’êš ṯiḇ·‘ar- dib·bar·tî bil·šō·w·nî
verses.literal: My heart grew hot within me as I mused the fire burned [Then] I spoke with my tongue

verses.original: הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀ קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה־ מַה־ הִ֑יא חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî Yah·weh qiṣ·ṣî ū·mid·daṯ yā·may ’ê·ḏə·‘āh meh- mah- hî ḥā·ḏêl ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Show me O LORD my end and the measure of my days Let me know . . . how . . . fleeting my life is

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗י טְפָח֨וֹת׀ וְחֶלְדִּ֣י כְאַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ אַ֥ךְ כָּֽל־ אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב הֶ֥בֶל כָּל־ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tāh yā·may ṭə·p̄ā·ḥō·wṯ wə·ḥel·dî ḵə·’a·yin neḡ·de·ḵā ’aḵ kāl- ’ā·ḏām niṣ·ṣāḇ he·ḇel kāl- se·lāh
verses.literal: You, indeed have made my days [as] handbreadths and my lifetime as nothing before You Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath . . . Selah

verses.original: אַךְ־ אִ֗ישׁ יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־ בְּצֶ֤לֶם׀ אַךְ־ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן הֶ֥בֶל יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽלֹא־ יֵדַ֥ע מִי־ אֹסְפָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- ’îš yiṯ·hal·leḵ- bə·ṣe·lem ’aḵ- ye·hĕ·mā·yūn he·ḇel yiṣ·bōr wə·lō- yê·ḏa‘ mî- ’ō·sə·p̄ām
verses.literal: Surely every man goes about like a phantom surely he bustles in vain he heaps up [riches] not knowing who will haul them away

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֑י מַה־ קִּוִּ֣יתִי תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗י לְךָ֣ הִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy mah- qiw·wî·ṯî tō·w·ḥal·tî lə·ḵā hî
verses.literal: And now O Lord for what do I wait My hope is in You

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֑נִי מִכָּל־ פְּשָׁעַ֥י אַל־ תְּשִׂימֵֽנִי׃ חֶרְפַּ֥ת נָ֝בָ֗ל
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî mik·kāl pə·šā·‘ay ’al- tə·śî·mê·nî ḥer·paṯ nā·ḇāl
verses.literal: Deliver me from all my transgressions do not make me the reproach of fools

verses.original: נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח־ פִּ֑י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
verses.literal: I have become mute I do not open my mouth because [of what] You have done

verses.original: הָסֵ֣ר נִגְעֶ֑ךָ מֵעָלַ֣י אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי׃ מִתִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְךָ֗
verses.transliteration: hā·sêr niḡ·‘e·ḵā mê·‘ā·lay ’ă·nî ḵā·lî·ṯî mit·tiḡ·raṯ yā·ḏə·ḵā
verses.literal: Remove Your scourge from me I am perishing by the force of Your hand

verses.original: יִסַּ֬רְתָּ בְּֽתוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת אִ֗ישׁ עַל־ עָוֺ֨ן׀ וַתֶּ֣מֶס כָּעָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑וֹ אַ֤ךְ כָּל־ אָדָ֣ם הֶ֖בֶל סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yis·sar·tā bə·ṯō·w·ḵā·ḥō·wṯ ’îš ‘al- ‘ā·wōn wat·te·mes kā·‘āš ḥă·mū·ḏōw ’aḵ kāl- ’ā·ḏām he·ḇel se·lāh
verses.literal: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity consuming like a moth what he holds dear surely each man [is] but a vapor Selah

verses.original: שִֽׁמְעָ֥ה־ תְפִלָּתִ֨י׀ יְהוָ֡ה הַאֲזִינָה֮ וְשַׁוְעָתִ֨י׀ אַֽל־ תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֶֽל־ דִּמְעָתִ֗י כִּ֤י אָנֹכִ֣י גֵ֣ר עִמָּ֑ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּכָל־ אֲבוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘āh- ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî Yah·weh ha·’ă·zî·nāh wə·šaw·‘ā·ṯî ’al- te·ḥĕ·raš ’el- dim·‘ā·ṯî kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ḡêr ‘im·māḵ tō·wō·šāḇ kə·ḵāl- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: Hear my prayer O LORD and give ear to my cry for help do not be deaf to my weeping For I am a foreigner dwelling with You a stranger like all my fathers

verses.original: הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣נִּי וְאַבְלִ֑יגָה בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃
verses.literal: Turn Your gaze away from me that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more
